raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Warner Bros. Nashville as an imprint under Warner Bros. Entertainment and pursued the Warner Bros. Discovery ownership chain. This conflated the film/TV company (Warner Bros. Entertainment) with the music company (Warner Music Group). Warner Bros. Nashville is part of Warner Music Group, whose controlling owner is Len Blavatnik via Access Industries. This misinterpretation of the corporate structure led the process toward the wrong owner.
